text:
zoe: hitting a weird TS inference fail when building the sample chat for edge ESM. repro below.

zoe: consumer code (Vite/esbuild):
```ts
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const reply = await client.generate<{ message: string }>({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi' })
console.log(reply.message)
```

zoe: TS error at build: 'No overload matches this call. Type inference failed for type parameter T.'

mira: this smells like overload vs module interop. our d.ts exposes both a default-style export and named functions for CJS compatibility, and TS sometimes picks the wrong signature when modules are rewritten by bundlers.

sam: short-term unblock: set esModuleInterop: true or import * as RI from '@redwood/inference' and use RI.createClient(...). Not ideal for sample apps.

jin: besides overload collisions, moduleResolution: 'bundler' combined with allowSyntheticDefaultImports:false causes the imported symbol to be seen as a namespace which can change overload resolution. We should document a minimal tsconfig for edge samples.

mira: proposal: simplify types into a single generic surface to avoid multiple competing overloads. Example:
```ts
export type GenerateReq<T = unknown> = { model: string; prompt: string }
export function generate<T = unknown>(req: GenerateReq<T>): Promise<T>
export function createClient(opts?: { apiKey?: string }): { generate: typeof generate }
export default createClient
```
This removes overload ordering problems and should be robust across ESM/CJS import shapes.

zoe: also noticed package.json ships both main + module but the .d.ts aligns with module export shape in one path and commonjs in another. We should publish a single consistent .d.ts or add a tiny cjs shim that sets exports.default = createClient.

sam: can we add a CI check that builds our sample with moduleResolution=bundler and esModuleInterop=false to catch regressions?

jin: yes. Action items: 1) open a types-only PR consolidating overloads, 2) add an edge-sample README with tsconfig recommendations (or change sample tsconfig to the compatible set), 3) add a CI job building the sample with bundler resolution.

zoe: i'll open the PR and include a minimal repro repo and failing CI job so reviewers can validate.

devex-bot: created issue #3567 (dx: edge ESM bundle breaks generic inference for SDK)

mira: thanks zoe, will review the types change once PR is up. :thumbsup:
